acceptance: The TPC-DS maintenance test and QphDS refresh use library write_refresh, byte-identical to dsdgen -update at SF 0.01 and 1 (set 1), with dsdgen absent in the test.
description:
## Problem
The TPC-DS maintenance test and QphDS take refresh data from dsdgen -update. C removal needs them on the library.

## Change
Route `generate_refresh_set` for the native backend through library write_refresh('tpcds').

## Decision gates
- If the 23 files differ from dsdgen at any tested scale, stop and report the file and first differing row.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; never kill processes by name pattern.
- No divergent fork of tpcgen-rs; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule (<= ~200 changed lines, upstream PR, SHA pin, README entry); anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first.
- Human commit identity, no agent attribution. Report only observed results.
